title: Software Engineering Intern - Internal Developer Platform
description:
We build Frontstage, TomTom's developer portal based on Backstage, and Watchtower, the service that collects data behind it. Together they help engineering teams see what software they own and how it is doing, for example on security, quality and cost.

What you'll do:
  • Join a friendly team of engineers and pick up a project of your own, with a mentor to guide you
  • Help build new pages and scorecards in Frontstage using TypeScript and React
  • Help extend Watchtower, our TypeScript and PostgreSQL backend, with new data sources and APIs
  • Work on features that matter to our users, for example showing teams what their services cost on our Kubernetes platform
  • Help keep Frontstage up to date with new Backstage releases
  • Participate in the full cycle: understanding what users need, designing a solution, building, testing and releasing it
  • Build iteratively using agile methodologies, with your code reviewed by the team

    • What you'll need:
  • Being enrolled in a Dutch university until at least September 2027, so the entire duration of the internship
  • Being located in Amsterdam or cities close by to be able to commute to the office at least twice a week
  • Available for at least 32h/week
  • Good TypeScript or JavaScript skills
  • Some experience building web applications, for example with React or Node.js
  • Basic knowledge of SQL and databases
  • Nice to have: experience with Backstage, Docker, GitHub Actions or a cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Solid Computer Science fundamentals
  • Comfortable with written and/or verbal communication in English
  • Interest in building tools that make other engineers' lives easier, and eager to learn

title: Software Engineering Intern - AI Platform Excellence
description:
We look after the AI tools TomTom engineers use every day, such as GitHub Copilot, Claude and Cursor, and the platform that gives teams access to AI models. We help teams use these tools well, keep an eye on usage and cost, and try out new tools as they appear.

What you'll do:
  • Join a friendly team of platform engineers and pick up a project of your own, with a mentor to guide you
  • Help build reports and dashboards that show how AI tools are used across TomTom and what they cost
  • Look into how engineers can get good results from AI tools while using fewer tokens, and share simple tips and tooling with them
  • Help improve our model gateway, for example by adding usage tracking or making it easier for teams to try new models
  • Take part in trying out new AI developer tools and help write down what works and what does not
  • Support the pilot of our AI-assisted ways of working with engineering teams, for example by collecting feedback and usage numbers
  • Build iteratively using agile methodologies, and learn how a platform team works day to day

    • What you'll need:
  • Being enrolled in a Dutch university until at least September 2027, so the entire duration of the internship
  • Being located in Amsterdam or cities close by to be able to commute to the office at least twice a week
  • Available for at least 32h/week
  • Good Python skills
  • Some experience using AI coding assistants or LLM APIs, for example in coursework or a side project
  • Basic knowledge of working with data (SQL, pandas or similar)
  • Nice to have: experience with GitHub Actions, APIs or a cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Solid Computer Science fundamentals
  • Comfortable with written and/or verbal communication in English
  • Curious about AI and eager to learn

title: Feltsense AI Engineer
description:
About the company

We raised $5.1M to build agents that operate as fully autonomous founders. Our backers include Matt Schlicht (founder of Moltbook), the founders of Crunchbase and Republic, and VCs including Draper, Precursor, and Liquid2.

We're working at the frontier of autonomous systems, building agents that don't just chat, but run entire businesses.

Our system identifies business opportunities through market signals, validates ideas with live ad tests, builds and launches software products, and brings in human experts wherever agents fall short. That loop already runs end to end: from idea to launched product to first revenue.

Over the next 12 months, our focus is on reliability, throughput, and self-improvement, making every launch better than the last.

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to take ownership of the architecture and development of our autonomous agent system.

You'll lead the technical direction of the platform, building multi-agent orchestration systems, self-improving agent harnesses, and AI-powered backend services. This is a highly technical leadership role that combines architectural decision-making with hands-on engineering.

You'll be expected to ship production code, make key technical decisions, improve agent behavior in production, and help establish the engineering standards as the company scales.

Responsibilities

  • Own the system architecture and make key technical decisions across the platform.

  • Design and build multi-agent systems and orchestration infrastructure that take products from idea to launch.
